messages.author: 9507d090705a9cd3
messages.subject: Accessing a sorted data table.
parts:
Hello,

How do I access a sorted data table?  Example, a file containing a matrix is loaded and rendered using the DT package.  A user clicks on a column and the matrix (table) is sorted and rendered.  How do I access this sorted data table for further processing?

Many thanks.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Accessing a sorted data table.
parts:
Please see http://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html You always have
access to the row indices of the table (be it sorted or not, filtered
or not, ...). Note you are recommended to use the current development
version of DT.

Regards,
Yihui
